# Kyoto Spring Trip Plan: 5 Relaxed Days for 2 Adults

A calm, walk-friendly Kyoto itinerary for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14** with a total on-the-ground budget of **JPY 180,000** for 2 adults, excluding international flights. I’ve kept the pace late-morning friendly, temple-focused, and centered on quiet neighborhoods, local food, and one easy day trip.

## 5-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Budget

| Day | Focus | Neighborhood Base | Estimated Cost for 2 | Pace |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | Arrival, Gion, Yasaka area, riverside walk | Gion / Higashiyama | JPY 28,000 | Relaxed |
| Apr 11 | Eastern temples and peaceful lanes | Higashiyama / Okazaki | JPY 30,000 | Relaxed |
| Apr 12 | Arashiyama and western Kyoto | Arashiyama / Uzumasa | JPY 34,000 | Moderate-relaxed |
| Apr 13 | Day trip to Nara | Kyoto Station / Central Kyoto | JPY 32,000 | Relaxed |
| Apr 14 | Zen gardens, last shopping, departure | Central Kyoto / Kyoto Station | JPY 26,000 | Light |

## Kyoto Day-by-Day Plan

### Day 1: Arrival, Gion, and a Gentle First Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take a slow lunch near your hotel.
- Afternoon: Walk **Gion**, Hanamikoji, and Yasaka Shrine; keep this as an orientation day rather than a sightseeing marathon.
- Evening: Stroll along the **Kamo River** and have a quiet izakaya or kaiseki-style dinner.
- Food: Yudofu, tofu skin dishes, or a simple seasonal set meal.
- Stay area: **Gion**, **Higashiyama**, or **Kyoto Station** if you want easier transit and more hotel choice.
- Estimated cost: Hotel JPY 16,000–22,000; meals JPY 8,000; local transport JPY 2,000.

### Day 2: Eastern Kyoto Temples and Calm Streets
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Start after a slow breakfast and visit **Kiyomizu-dera** or **Kodai-ji**.
- Afternoon: Walk through **Ninenzaka**, **Sannenzaka**, and the quieter lanes toward **Shoren-in** or **Maruyama Park**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Walk through **Ninenzaka**, **Sannenzaka**, and the quieter lanes toward **Shoren-in** or **Maruyama Park**, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Early dinner in **Okazaki** or back in **Gion**; keep the night open for a tea stop or dessert.
- Food: Kyoto vegetables, matcha sweets, obanzai.
- Stay area: **Higashiyama** for the best walking access.
- Estimated cost: Temple admissions and transit JPY 4,000; meals JPY 8,000; hotel JPY 18,000–22,000.

### Day 3: Arashiyama, Bamboo Grove, and Riverside Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Leave after 9:00 AM for **Arashiyama**; visit **Tenryu-ji** and the **Bamboo Grove**.
- Afternoon: Cross **Togetsukyo Bridge**, then choose either a slow riverside walk or a taxi/bus hop to a quieter temple like **Jojakko-ji** or **Gio-ji**.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto and enjoy a calm dinner near your hotel.
- Food: Yuba, soba, grilled river fish, or a tofu lunch set.
- Stay area: **Arashiyama** if you want a scenic ryokan feel; otherwise stay central and day-trip in.
- Estimated cost: Transit JPY 3,000; admissions JPY 3,000; meals JPY 8,000; hotel JPY 20,000–24,000.

### Day 4: Easy Day Trip to Nara
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Take a mid-morning train to **Nara**; no need for an early start.
- Afternoon: Visit **Todai-ji**, **Nara Park**, and the quieter paths around **Kasuga Taisha** if energy is good.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/25/DeerNaraJapan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Visit **Todai-ji**, **Nara Park**, and the quieter paths around **Kasuga Taisha** if energy is good, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Return to Kyoto for a late, easy dinner and an early night.
- Food: Kakinoha sushi, mochi, or a set lunch near Nara Park.
- Stay area: **Kyoto Station** or **Central Kyoto** for the easiest train access.
- Estimated cost: Train JPY 2,000; admissions JPY 2,000; meals JPY 8,000; hotel JPY 20,000.

### Day 5: Zen Garden Morning and Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- Morning: Visit **Ryōan-ji** or **Ninna-ji** for a quieter final temple morning.
- Afternoon: Light shopping for tea, ceramics, or sweets in **Central Kyoto**; keep luggage time in mind.
- Evening: Depart or enjoy a final early dinner if your flight is later.
- Food: Matcha parfait, wagashi, or a final tofu meal.
- Stay area: **Kyoto Station** if you want the smoothest departure day.
- Estimated cost: Admissions JPY 2,000; meals JPY 6,000; transport JPY 2,000; hotel if needed JPY 16,000–18,000.

## Neighborhood Suggestions for a Relaxed Stay

| Neighborhood | Best For | Why It Fits | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gion / Higashiyama | Temples, atmosphere, walking | Beautiful streets, easy access to classic sights | Fewer large hotels, higher room rates |
| Kyoto Station | Convenience, trains, day trip base | Best for Nara and arrival/departure logistics | Less atmospheric than old Kyoto |
| Central Kyoto / Kawaramachi | Food, shopping, transit | Good balance of access and dining | Busier than temple districts |
| Arashiyama | Scenic ryokan feel, nature | Lovely for one slower night or two | Less central for the rest of the trip |

## Budget Plan for 2 Adults

| Category | Target Range | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel or ryokan | JPY 80,000–100,000 | Mid-range double room or simple ryokan, 4 nights |
| Food and drinks | JPY 35,000–45,000 | Mix of lunches, casual dinners, tea stops |
| Local transport | JPY 10,000–15,000 | Trains, buses, a few taxis when useful |
| Admissions | JPY 8,000–12,000 | Temples, gardens, and one day trip entry fees |
| Snacks, shopping, buffer | JPY 15,000–20,000 | Tea, sweets, small souvenirs, extra taxi cushion |
| Total | **JPY 148,000–192,000** | Keep hotel near the lower-middle end to stay within budget |

Best fit for your budget: aim for **JPY 18,000–22,000 per night** on average and keep lunches casual, which should keep the trip comfortably within **JPY 180,000**.

## Spring Packing List for Kyoto in April

- Light waterproof jacket or compact umbrella
- Layered tops: T-shirts, long sleeves, and one light sweater
- Comfortable walking shoes with good grip
- Socks you can easily remove for temple visits
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Portable charger and charging cable
- Reusable water bottle
- Tissues and hand sanitizer
- Light scarf for cool mornings and evenings
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- One slightly dressier outfit for a nicer dinner or ryokan meal
- Any allergy medicine, since spring pollen can be noticeable
